title: Mary Peltola delays campaign events after sustaining ‘minor injuries’ in car crash - NBC News
description: Former Rep. Mary Peltola is rescheduling several upcoming campaign events after she and her family sustained “minor” injuries in a car crash, her campaign announced on Sunday.

title: Le Pen casts herself as protector of France as troubles swirl - POLITICO.eu
description: The front-runner ahead of the 2027 presidential election is under pressure to reassure voters as turmoil grips France.

title: Bengals step up after debilitating first half to complete 35-13 comeback over Ravens - WLWT
description: Joe Burrow threw four touchdown passes in the second half, and the Cincinnati Bengals rebounded from a desultory first two quarters to beat Baltimore 35-13 on Sunday, handing the Ravens a second straight divisional loss with Lamar Jackson sidelined.

title: Opposition leader María Machado returns to Venezuela - BBC
description: Machado had left the country just a month before the US government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

title: AP Top 25: BYU tumbles to No. 8 after loss to UCF as Ohio State and Georgia move up on bye weeks - Yahoo Sports
description: As Ohio State and Georgia moved up without playing, Notre Dame fell despite being off.
